entities.summary: Orø is a small island in Denmark located in the Isefjord within Holbæk Municipality. The island covers 14 km2 and has a population of 1020. There are four villages on Orø: Bybjerg, the largest village on the island with a population of 276, Brønde, Gamløse and Næsby.
